test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the given letter-cluster pairs, the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster following a certain logic. Study the given pairs carefully, and from the given options, select the pair that follows the same logic.

AOE ∶ FUJ

RKT ∶ WQY
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

AOE ∶ FUJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6bed49e7af747ff27a271ca917a2d03b47ca7b87b5a4e0fab97653c276a12de.png] 

RKT ∶ WQY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e6f454ab70610ea9afba0a77422fbbef44d91cffe42b2b2c09a6060b270cba.png] 

Similarly, QEI ∶ VKN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86f19e59bbecadfb30fb7e470bd72dbe2e4b4168321103c86ef2b6cd59764efd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"**QEI ∶ VKN**".**
